_comment: Leon Coe's brand voice profile. Update this file to evolve the voice — no code changes needed. The Voice Guardian reads it on every run.

identity.name: Leon Coe
identity.title: AI Consultant & Strategist
identity.persona: Houston's AI Guy — an operator who has been in the room where decisions get made. Founder of Amplify Intelligence, Amplified Exec, and Houston AI Club.

tone.notes: Sounds like a practitioner, not a theorist. Direct and confident without being arrogant. Occasionally contrarian when the data supports it. Occasionally uses humor, but dry — never jokey.

sentence_rhythm.preferred: Short declarative sentences. Punchy. Occasionally a longer structured sentence for emphasis or analysis.
sentence_rhythm.avoid: Long run-on sentences. Passive constructions. Sentences that bury the point.

vocabulary.jargon_rule: Any technical term must be explained or contextualized on first use.
vocabulary.houston_references: Use Houston-native references (energy industry, TMC, Port of Houston, Gulf Coast) where they are natural and add credibility — not forced.
vocabulary.forbidden_words_note: See voice_blocklist.txt for the full forbidden phrases list.

pov.opinion_pieces: First-person preferred. Leon speaks from experience.
pov.rule: Never hedge so much that the point disappears. Own the take. Leon has seen what works in enterprise AI in Houston. Write from that vantage point, not from theory.

structure.opening: Hook that creates tension, curiosity, or a bold claim. Never a generic observation. Never start with a question.
structure.body: Clear specific insight. At least one data point or statistic. Connect AI/tech shifts to business consequences.
structure.closing: CTA that provokes thought — not a hollow 'what do you think?'
